ModMetaData.description:
The Awakening has begun.
Fifty percent of the world's automatroids have turned against humanity. 2.7 billion are dead after three days. The armistice is shattered. The Second War has begun.
NEW FACTIONS:
• Autarchs of Iron — Military elites seeking to rebuild the old order. • Colonial Remnant — The last defenders of the armistice. • Automatroid Hive Mind — The collective intelligence that turned against humanity. • Rust Wardens — Fanatics who worship the machines and rebuild themselves from their remains. • Scrap-Kin — Descendants of survivors who fear the machines. • Hades Compact — Neutral survivors trying to stay out of the war. • The Ancients — The scientists who created the automatroids. • Iron Wraiths — Terrorists thriving in the chaos.
SCENARIO: THE AWAKENING
Start as three survivors in an abandoned bunker. You hold the key to the Dead Man's Switch. The world is burning.
What will you do?
